title: IvyDB TradeFlow documentation and data-feasibility audit

product.name: IvyDB TradeFlow
product.advertised_coverage: Every U.S. option, all U.S. options exchanges (vendor claim; not independently sample-verified)
product.record_grain: Option series aggregated by reporting interval; exact interval boundaries and cumulative-versus-incremental semantics require raw-sample verification

stages: screen trade conditions indicating execution against a previously posted passive order
classify remaining trades with exchange-auction price-improvement characteristics
compare remaining trades with prevailing quote; nearer offer is buyer-initiated and nearer bid is seller-initiated
resolve midpoint trades with supplementary contemporaneous market information
classify remaining unresolved trades by price movement versus the prior trade

participant_proxies.retail_1: SLAN single-leg auction prints below 10 contracts; strictest vendor retail proxy
participant_proxies.retail_2: Automatic executions below 10 contracts at bid or offer; vendor notes some institutional-algorithmic contamination
participant_proxies.retail_3: Automatic executions below 10 contracts and below $5,000 notional inside the NBBO; vendor describes as consistent with wholesaler internalization
participant_proxies.institutional_1: ISOs executing at or through the prevailing quote
participant_proxies.institutional_2: Institutional 1 plus automatic executions at or through the quote exceeding both 10 contracts and $5,000 notional

microstructure_semantics.trade_conditions: Per-condition trade counts by direction and lot-size bucket
microstructure_semantics.total_volume_reconciliation: at_NBBO + inside_NBBO + outside_NBBO; do not add midpoint separately
microstructure_semantics.signed_exchange: Venue-level volume by direction; vendor says venue rows reconcile to Signed_Volume

historical_field_coverage.reason: The 2024 Signed Volume brochure says lot-size fields begin in 2021; the 2026 TradeFlow brochure advertises every option daily since 2016 but does not state per-field backfill dates. Do not assume the new size/participant fields are homogeneous back to 2016.

ivydb_us_intraday.security_identity: Permanent instrument IDs plus underlying names/ticker-change history are advertised
ivydb_us_intraday.delivery: Nightly FTP updates are stated in the 2025 brochure
ivydb_us_intraday.use: Potential delta/IV/skew marks for TradeFlow; three daily snapshots do not provide exact trade-time Greeks for every 5-minute interval

cboe_open_close.distinction: Cboe provides capacity and open/close position-side buckets on Cboe venues; TradeFlow provides aggressor-side classification across all U.S. options exchanges
cboe_open_close.interpretation: Do not treat the two classification systems as equivalent or either as beneficial-owner identity

data_gates.gate: Per-year, per-underlying, per-contract and inactive/delisted coverage
Exact 5-minute/30-minute interval boundaries and cumulative-versus-incremental semantics
Late trades, cancellations, corrections and revision vintages
Historical methodology version and uniform backfill of new classifier
Lot-size and participant-proxy field history (2016 versus 2021)
Security-ID continuity for TradeFlow inactive/delisted contracts and underlying corporate actions
Raw sample and full data dictionary
Price, internal-use license and derived-data rights
TradeFlow versus IvyDB US Intraday timestamp alignment for delta/IV joins

candidate_hypotheses_not_tested.definition: Institutional 2 buyer-initiated minus seller-initiated volume, delta/multiplier/underlying-price weighted where time-aligned Greeks exist
Retail 1, Retail 2 and Retail 3 separately, with mutually exclusive aggregation only after validation
All buyer-initiated minus seller-initiated volume, with unclassified volume retained as a separate quality feature
Condition-code, NBBO-location and venue concentration/dispersion features
candidate_hypotheses_not_tested.interpretation: Microstructure/liquidity controls, not standalone smart-money labels

candidate_hypotheses_not_tested.definition: Interactions between signed flow and contemporaneous IV/skew/term structure
candidate_hypotheses_not_tested.interpretation: Test whether flow contains information beyond hedging/volatility repricing

no_lookahead_and_validation.first_use: No feature admission until actual first-receipt timestamps and correction-vintage rules are verified; EOD features become usable only after actual receipt, never by nominal trade date alone
no_lookahead_and_validation.intraday: Use only the snapshot actually received by the decision timestamp; do not backfill later corrections into earlier snapshots
no_lookahead_and_validation.interval_semantics: Do not difference or sum snapshots until the vendor confirms interval versus cumulative semantics and correction handling
no_lookahead_and_validation.identity: Use effective-dated option/security identity; do not backdate current ticker mappings
no_lookahead_and_validation.greeks: For delta-equivalent flow, use only contemporaneously available Greeks or a preregistered lagged prior snapshot; never use a later 15:45 Greek for earlier intervals
no_lookahead_and_validation.model_comparison: Incremental tests versus frozen LTM/F80 with identical exposure and costs; chronological development/validation; block bootstrap and leave-one-out; preserve the locked final holdout
no_lookahead_and_validation.holding_periods: Evaluate multiple horizons without imposing a fixed minimum or maximum holding period
no_lookahead_and_validation.return_chasing: Control for same-day/prior underlying returns, IV/skew changes, liquidity, event calendar, DTE/moneyness and option volume
